meta.metric: organic click-through rate as a fraction (0 to 1)

beyond_table_position.note: positions past 20 use the position-20 floor; such ranks earn near-zero clicks now, so their winnable upside is large and correct

provenance_states.confirmed: exact value stated in the primary source text
provenance_states.interpolated: monotone log-linear fill between two confirmed anchors; not a source value
provenance_states.extrapolated: log-linear tail past the last confirmed anchor; not a source value
provenance_states.derived: computed from a confirmed source value (here a SISTRIX position-1 layout CTR), not a directly stated factor

sources.author: Johannes Beus
sources.title: Why (almost) everything you knew about Google CTR is no longer valid

sources.author: Seer Interactive
sources.title: AI Overviews impact on Google CTR, September 2025 update
sources.scope: 3,119 informational queries, 42 organizations, Jun 2024 to Sep 2025

limits: A single curve is a crude approximation; CTR varies by intent, brand, device, and industry. Reported as a band, never a single number.
Advanced Web Ranking publishes a fuller position 1 to 20 curve but serves it from a JavaScript chart, so its per-position numbers were not capturable; SISTRIX anchors are used instead.
Positions 4 to 9 and 11 to 20 are filled by formula, not by the source.
SERP-feature factors are derived from SISTRIX position-1 layout CTRs and applied as the single strongest suppression among present features, not multiplied, to avoid compounding uncertainty.
Features without a confirmed value (paa, local_pack, video, news, images, sitelinks-as-suppressor) carry factor 1.0 and are marked unmeasured; the band absorbs the unknown.
